The Mountaineers, led by sixth-year head coach [[Dustin Kerns]], played their home games at the [[Holmes Center]] in [[Boone, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Sun Belt Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2023–24 Appalachian State Mountaineers men's basketball team|Mountaineers]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 27–7, 16–2 in Sun Belt play to finish as the [[2023–24 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball season|2023–24 Sun Belt regular season champions]]. The Mountaineers lost to [[2023–24 Arkansas State Red Wolves men's basketball team|Arkansas State]] in the second round of the [[2024 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]]. They lost to [[2023–24 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Wake Forest]] in the first round of the [[2024 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]].{{cite web|title=App State Men's Basketball Falls in NIT First Round|url=https://sunbeltsports.org/news/2024/3/20/app-state-mens-basketball-falls-in-nit-first-round.aspx|website=Sun Belt Sports|access-date=August 24, 2024|date=March 20, 2024}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
